hero.title: More Than Three Decades.
hero.description: Al-Fadlabi Perfumes & Cosmetics is a Sudanese company specializing in perfumes, cosmetics, and personal care products, with more than three decades of experience in the industry.
hero.years: Of experience in perfumes, cosmetics & personal care

story.title: A trusted name, built over time.
story.paragraph1: Since our establishment, we have been committed to building a trusted name in the market by providing a diverse range of products that meet the needs of consumers, while focusing on quality, variety, competitive pricing, and customer service.
story.paragraph2: Over the years, the company has grown from a traditional trading business into an integrated organization involved in the sourcing, marketing, and distribution of a wide range of personal care and beauty products.
story.paragraph3: As the market continues to evolve, we remain attentive to changing consumer preferences and committed to providing products that meet the needs of the people we serve.

offerings.title: A broad world of care.
offerings.introduction: From fragrance and beauty to sourcing, importing, and distribution, our work connects products with the people and markets that need them.

perfumes.title: Perfumes
perfumes.description: We offer a diverse range of perfumes and fragrance products designed to suit different preferences and occasions, with a strong focus on quality, lasting performance, and variety.

cosmetics.title: Cosmetics & Personal Care
cosmetics.description: We provide a wide selection of cosmetics and personal care products, including skin care, hair care, body care, hygiene, and everyday personal care products.

soap.title: Soaps & Skin Care
soap.description: We offer a variety of soaps and skin care products in different formulations and sizes, designed to meet the needs of different segments of the market.

sourcing.title: Sourcing & Distribution
sourcing.description: We source and supply products through a network of trusted suppliers and business partners, with a strong focus on reliable supply, product availability, and meeting market demand.

trading.title: Trading & Import
trading.description: Our experience extends to working with international markets and suppliers. We carefully select products and brands that meet the needs of the local market while managing purchasing, shipping, and supply operations.

service.title: Distribution & Customer Service
service.description: We believe in building long-term relationships with our customers and business partners by ensuring product availability, understanding market needs, and providing professional service focused on customer satisfaction.

growth.title: From a trading business to an integrated organization.
growth.paragraph: Over more than three decades, our work has expanded across sourcing, marketing, importing, and distribution. That growth has allowed us to build a broader understanding of the market while continuing to adapt to changing needs and preferences.
growth.caption: Experience · Adaptability · Continuity

commitment.title: The principles behind our work.
commitment.description: Our approach is grounded in the things that have mattered throughout our journey: providing the right products, maintaining reliable supply, and building lasting relationships.

closing.title: A story built around products, people, and trust.
closing.description: Explore our collection and discover the fragrances and products we bring to our customers.
